_comment: Mixamo FBX clips for VRM targets. animationRuntime.playFBXAnimation retargets mixamorig:* bones onto the VRM humanoid + scales hips translation cm→m. MMD/PMX models silently skip — they don't share Mixamo's bone topology. Drop files into <category>/<name>.fbx, register here with the same motion-name keys as the VRMA/VMD manifests. Empty by default — licensing-safe.
